core_obligations: High-frequency hyperbolic packet obstruction does not construct controls for the coupled parabolic branch. The author holomorphic spectral splitting, transport-time control and parabolic regularization estimates solve the coupled high-frequency control problem, then handle the remaining finite-dimensional modes to obtain null controllability above the original geometric threshold with full component control.
